title: Lights on a road stretch at Mattibu, Gotland

plain: On Gotland, an island in Sweden, there is a place called Mattibu where people go to a certain stretch of road to watch for lights that wander along it. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels about the spot as local lore, with no date, as an example of places where odd lights keep being reported.
